paper.use: METHOD ONLY: tool checks bound to the artefact checked, a fidelity audit as a separate human decision, a human decision at a fixed point, an explicit split of an ambiguous claim, and a dialog report attributing work to human, AI and tool. The paper's tool layer (computer algebra, numerics, proof assistant; statistics packages) is not used; toy deterministic tools stand in. No paper text, figures, tables or data are copied into this directory: README.md, NOTICE and the code paraphrase the method in their own words, and this file records locations, number tokens and span hashes only (no span text). The PDF was not read.

paper_example.note: The paper applies its mathematics tool layer to a small example with two claims; one claim is ambiguous and is cut into two readings, of which the tools prove one and refute the other. That example, its tools and its outcome are not reproduced or checked here. not_results_of_this_sketch: All claims, artefacts, tool results, human records, seeds and outcomes here are synthetic and deterministic. The tools are two toy integer-identity tools; nothing here checks a real proof, manuscript or translation.
